# Bbag

> India's premier online stationery store offering notebooks, pens, planners, and office supplies from leading brands with fast shipping and competitive deals.

Bbag is a comprehensive e-commerce platform specializing in stationery and writing instruments for students, professionals, and office environments across India. The store features curated collections from trusted brands like Doms, Luxor, Pilot, Uniball, and Creative Convert.
